post.text:
My neighbor bought a new Cybertruck this week because Tesla's gonna stop selling Autopilot and he got one just in time so he doesn't have to pay a subscription for it.

He doesn't need a truck. He works in insurance and his biggest cargo is a laptop bag.

But now I have to park
post.author_description: I am a proud IT Unprofessional with 25+ years of experience turning computers off and on. Did you try blowing on it? IT support @deel
